name: Fibo 2 Edit Turbo ComfyUI
readme:
# Fibo 2 ComfyUI

Runpod standard ports:
- 8188: ComfyUI and model preparation progress.
- 8888: JupyterLab, rooted at /workspace; use Runpod Connect.
- 8080: FileBrowser, rooted at /workspace.
- 22: SSH.

Deploy → Connect → ComfyUI (8188) → upload an image → describe an edit → Run. ComfyUI keeps per-Pod login protection: open 8188 and enter the Jupyter token from Runpod Connect once. Set FIBO_PASSWORD to use Basic authentication instead. JupyterLab keeps its normal token login on 8888. FileBrowser username is admin; its initial password is FILEBROWSER_PASSWORD when set, otherwise the Jupyter token used on its first boot. FileBrowser retains its password in persistent storage.

Use a CUDA 13-compatible GPU with at least 24 GB VRAM, a 60 GB container disk and persistent storage at /workspace. Three SHA256-verified edit model files total 17.62 GB. User files live in /workspace/ComfyUI. The edit workflow supports Scale and optional width/height overrides. The optional Dev creation installer adds one 8.41 GB checkpoint and a text-to-image workflow.

The explicit startup command is /opt/fibo/scripts/entrypoint.sh. It initializes the usual SSH and Jupyter services and supervises FileBrowser and ComfyUI. The model backend stays private on loopback port 8189.

Fibo weights are CC BY-NC 4.0. Commercial use requires a separate Bria agreement: https://platform.bria.ai/licensing/pricing?model=fibo-2

Source, image identity and dated validation scope: https://github.com/akhilsivanand/fibo-runpod
